segments.title: Election Night Opening & Early Calls
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors solo from the BIN newsroom, calling California for Harris via DIY graphic, reacting to live Google map fluctuations, and delivering the 'Skiantz of the Moment' before a science trigger.

segments.title: Liliana Desk Check-In & Early Returns
segments.notes: Liliana joins Case at the desk to analyze early county-level data, discuss the Selzer poll miss in Iowa, and assess the 'flippy floppies' in Pennsylvania and Georgia.

segments.title: Trailer Break: Air Force One, White House Down & One Million Dollar
segments.notes: Trent (on community service) joins Case to watch presidential-action-movie trailers and a mysterious Jason Momoa/Kassim comedy trailer titled 'One Million Dollar' filmed in 2022.

segments.title: Kendall Map Deep-Dive & Gay Furry Comfort
segments.notes: Kendall appears for a satirical brain-zoom analysis of a Pennsylvania voter, delivers a 'never forget your tail' comfort line for gay furries, and makes a cryptic remark about children in China.

segments.title: MSNBC Kornaki Cam & Twitter Doom Scroll
segments.notes: Case monitors the MSNBC live camera of Steve Kornacki, reads doomer tweets from a previously bullish pollster, and notes AP calling the first transgender House member.

segments.title: Internet Video Palate Cleansers
segments.notes: Case airs a Simpsons 'Kang & Kodos' clip, a violent Tickle Me Elmo video, a 'Town Talk' parody trailer, and a 1991 kid-dancing video rated 8.93 by AP.

segments.title: Map Vigil & JD Vance Impression
segments.notes: Case tracks tightening swing-state margins, performs a JD Vance impression debating himself about couch discourse, and confirms Virginia for Harris.

segments.title: Minesweeper Tutorial & Neighbor Stalker Story
segments.notes: Kendall teaches Minesweeper to calm election nerves while recounting a year-long neighbor harassment saga involving moaning, mocking, and synchronized door openings.

segments.title: Post-Midnight Analysis & CBS Coverage
segments.notes: Case delivers a monologue on Harris campaign missteps, watches CBS panel discussion on tariffs and deficit, and reflects on 2016/2020 parallels.

segments.title: How To Build a Bunker (Leaky Edition)
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget reviews his own three-year-old bunker build, listing regrets: fried keypad, low headroom, water intrusion, missing secondary exit, and a leaky culvert pipe.

segments.title: Final Swing-State Tally & AP Georgia Call
segments.notes: Case and Gina track Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Arizona, Nevada; AP calls Georgia for Trump; Gina suffers a dramatic nosebleed attributed to JD Vance.

segments.title: Election Night Cipher & Sign-Off
segments.notes: DJ Newsic hosts a multi-guest rap cipher (Crum, DJ Newsic, Peter Gibbon, Rick, Tyler, Sammy) over shifting beats, ending with a state-by-state rap rundown and Case's final 'don't hit the panic button' sign-off.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the full 3-hour election night broadcast, called states via DIY graphics, performed a JD Vance impression, and closed with a 'don't hit the panic button' sign-off.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Joined Case for early returns analysis, discussed Selzer poll miss and Pennsylvania county dynamics.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Delivered satirical brain-zoom map analysis, comforted gay furries with 'never forget your tail', revealed neighbor stalker saga during Minesweeper tutorial.
lore_notes: [01:36:02] Neighbor has harassed Kendall and Case for ~1.5 years, including moaning Case's name and appearing synchronously when Case leaves apartment.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Participated in late-night debate segment and DJ Newsic cipher, claimed not to care about election outcome while drinking a single beer.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Crum in DC studio, won flash poll on 'who wears a suit better' (penguins), declared 'I feel like a winner' as results trended Trump.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosted 'How To Build a Bunker' segment from his workshop, critiqued his own leaky culvert-pipe bunker with condensation and headroom issues.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: musical finale host. Hosted the election night cipher with rotating beats, performed state-by-state rap rundown, and closed the broadcast.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Appeared in DJ Newsic cipher claiming rats in the walls predicted the election and 'called up to Peter G at the end of the freaking night'.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: Amongst the Web host. Delivered a verse in DJ Newsic cipher asserting 'we were gonna make sure you were fucked either way' from inside the walls.

characters.name: Tyler
characters.notes: call-in guest. Rapped about voting for love, blood color physics, and 'don't stress everybody' during DJ Newsic cipher.

characters.name: Sammy
characters.notes: call-in guest. Delivered angry parking-and-pajamas verse during DJ Newsic cipher, claimed wife made him clean pajamas after 'slammies'.

characters.name: Gina
characters.notes: correspondent. Suffered dramatic nosebleed ('squibs in her nose') while reporting swing-state updates, attributed reaction to seeing JD Vance.
lore_notes: [02:43:05] Nosebleed triggered by JD Vance appearance; 'all the blood collects in her forehead and it must be released by the nose'.

lore_notes.fact: [01:36:02] Kendall reveals neighbor has harassed her and Case for ~1.5 years, including moaning Case's name through walls and appearing synchronously when Case exits apartment.
[02:04:58] Jeb Nogget's bunker built three years ago has condensation leaks, fried digital keypad, insufficient headroom, and no secondary exit.
[02:43:05] Gina's nosebleeds are a recurring physiological response to JD Vance appearances ('all the blood collects in her forehead and it must be released by the nose').

episode_summary: Barely Informed News provided continuous election night coverage from the BIN newsroom and a remote DC debate studio, blending swing-state map vigilance with trailer breaks, a Minesweeper tutorial, a bunker-building retrospective, and a multi-guest rap cipher. As returns trended toward Trump in key battlegrounds, the broadcast oscillated between doomer analysis and absurdist comfort segments, culminating in DJ Newsic's state-by-state musical rundown and Case Blackwell's final admonition not to hit the panic button.
